Decision records
0001 — TypeScript-first, local-first architecture
0002 — Add Go as a first-class detector ecosystem
0003 — Generate host plugins from shared Offing assets
0004 — Key lifecycle rules by PURL and VERS with provenance
0005 — Draft lifecycle rules with importers; never write the registry
0006 — Ship lifecycle data as a versioned, content-addressed bundle
0007 — Detect end-of-life container base images from Dockerfiles and Compose files
0008 — Detect removed and deprecated Kubernetes APIs in manifests, Helm charts, and kustomizations
0009 — Detect end-of-support JDK releases and relocated Maven dependencies in JVM projects
0010 — Record announced end-of-life dates that have not happened yet
0011 — Detect unsupported Rust toolchains and abandoned or yanked crates
0012 — Detect unsupported .NET targets and deprecated NuGet packages
0013 — Detector maturity levels and the evidence to move between them
0014 — Detect retired CI runner images
0015 — Corpus fetch strategy: sparse checkout, concurrency 16
0016 — CLI exit codes and error codes
0017 — Do not read OpenEoX documents yet; keep CLE as the interchange target
0018 — Ship v0.8.0 (adoption) and v0.9.0 (visibility) before v1
0019 — Privacy-first adoption metrics; opt-in telemetry only after v1
0020 — License the lifecycle dataset under CC BY 4.0
0021 — Ship adoption and visibility as one release, with one launch
0022 — Match Python TestCase method calls with a method shape
0023 — Define reference quality as measurable, enforced criteria
0024 — CI lanes: pull request, merge queue, main, nightly, release
0025 — Choose ESLint with typescript-eslint for lint, Biome for format
0026 — Document the public API on declarations and enforce it with lint
0027 — Keep fixtures out of scanners' sight with neutral names, not dismissals
0028 — Publish a self-contained MCP output schema and fail closed on a dangling $ref
0029 — Cut scanner complexity by extracting the line masker and replacing branch chains with tables
0030 — Select corpus repositories independently of results; target 200 per ecosystem
0031 — Layered architecture and the allowed-imports table
0032 — Split the MCP server into one file per tool with a small registry
0033 — Require the retrieval date on every source of every lifecycle record
0034 — Publish the detector limits in the SDK
0035 — One error model with stable reason codes
0036 — Add Deno and Elixir to the public validation schema
0037 — Recommend a release line from bundled data only
0038 — Add coverage gaps to forecast v1
0039 — Include replacement guidance in snippet findings
0040 — Keep MCP tool answers short, and say what is missing
0041 — Add the report's buckets to forecast v1
